test_title: RRB NTPC - UG 2025 (CBT 1) Mid-Range Full Test - 04
subject: general
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1841bea3b0828fe76901582d3333aba5da32a8957b1640f354fa569f5c11f0f8.png] 

The logic followed here is,

Logic: The difference between consecutive letters is +3 and +6.

Option 1) HKQ:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a072a3fdd8d641c21213767df2b1269d4c69341655c9301f1fb641d58d2e40f2.png] 

The difference between consecutive letters is +3 and +6.

Option 2) BEK:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b2f98cdbd72067a1e32055ebb173e202f3709d98bb5fbc65f2f8f76622f2519e.png] 

The difference between consecutive letters is +3 and +6.

**Option 3) OIG:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3491686b94ee617dff746f4f6c0612221107e08832b2a5559190a0cec6bb13cd.png] 

**The difference between consecutive letters is -6 and -2.**

**OIG does not follow the pattern.**

Option 4) LOU:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b6852e53b501cc813404f56a882c5386639e6ee58ec1a79b62fc4e96d821f13d.png] 

The difference between consecutive letters is +3 and +6.

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 3".**
